Drawing DWG-C-0003 rev A, sheet 1/1: System C – anode loop schematic.
Components:
- C-EXH: Exhaust outlet
- C-H2S: Hydrogen supply
- C-STK: Fuel cell stack
- C-PRG: Anode purge valve
- C-HRB: Hydrogen recirculation blower
Line list:
- L06 Hydrogen from C-H2S (Hydrogen supply) to C-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L07 Anode recirculation from C-STK (Fuel cell stack) to C-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower)
- L08 Anode recirculation from C-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower) to C-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L09 Purge gas from C-STK (Fuel cell stack) to C-PRG (Anode purge valve)
- L10 Purge gas from C-PRG (Anode purge valve) to C-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
